# Edina Pet Hospital

> > Edina Pet Hospital is an AAHA-accredited veterinary clinic in Minnesota offering comprehensive pet care including wellness exams, surgery, dental care, diagnostics, grooming, and 24-hour emergency referrals.

Located in Edina, Minnesota, Edina Pet Hospital provides full-service veterinary care for pets with a team of experienced veterinarians including Dr. Tara Herold, Dr. Cheasick, and Dr. Bennin. The clinic features a mobile app for appointment booking, pet records management, and loyalty rewards.

## Key Topics

- Wellness exams
- Pet dental care
- Surgical services
- Diagnostics (X-ray, ultrasound, lab)
- Pet grooming
- Emergency care
- Vaccinations
- Flea/tick prevention
- Microchipping
- AAHA-accredited
- Appointment booking
- Pet pharmacy
- Cremation services
- New client intake
- Pet health app

## Core Services

- [Animal Wellness Center](https://edinapethospital.com/animal-wellness-center): Wellness exams, vaccinations, flea/tick prevention, and microchipping services.
- [Animal Hospital Surgery](https://edinapethospital.com/animal-hospital-surgery): Surgical services including spaying, neutering, and advanced procedures.
- [Pet Dental Care](https://edinapethospital.com/pet-dental-care): Professional pet dental cleanings and oral health services.
- [Animal Diagnostics](https://edinapethospital.com/animal-diagnostics): Diagnostic services with digital X-rays, ultrasound, and lab testing.
- [Pet Grooming](https://edinapethospital.com/pet-grooming): Full grooming services including cat grooming and creative grooming options.
- [Animal Veterinary Care](https://edinapethospital.com/animal-veterinary-care): Comprehensive veterinary care including pharmacy and cremation services.

## Emergency & Urgent Care

- [Emergency Care](https://edinapethospital.com/emergencies): Emergency and urgent care services with 24-hour partner clinic referrals in Minnesota.
